notes.title: LATAM Spanish Subtitles Now Available! (Patch 1.0.13.0)
notes.notes:

Hola Metaphor fans, LATAM Spanish subtitles are now available for Metaphor: ReFantazio! We’re delighted to bring this support for our Latin American audience and hope even more players can now experience this adventure. 

Have fun and enjoy the journey! 
¡Diviértanse y disfruten el viaje!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.11
notes.notes:
Hi Metaphor: ReFantazio players, patch 1.0.11 is now available. Please see the change notes below: 

[list]
[*] Now able to change party formation and configuration in Main Menu > EQUIPMENT 
[*] Now able to cycle through item categories in Main Menu > ITEM 
[*] Adjusted character and cursor movement controlled by controller sticks 
[*] Other minor fixes 
[/list]Thank you for playing Metaphor: ReFantazio!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.09
notes.notes:
Hi Metaphor: ReFantazio players, patch 1.09 is now available. Please see the notes below:

[list]
[*] New ON/OFF toggle setting for motion blur animation when dashing.
[i]*Dash effects setting can be changed from SETTINGS > System Setting > Dash Effects.[/i]
[*] Fixed an issue where a quest in the Catacombs cannot be completed under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue where progression is blocked when enemies with status ailments conduct certain actions.
[*] Expedited the animation when displaying the popularity ranking.
[*] Fixed an issue in which certain mouse controls were not functioning properly.
[*] Fixed an issue in which button shortcuts did not appear properly when using a controller under certain conditions.
[*] Improved support for AZERTY keyboards.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]
The patch will be applied automatically when the game is launched.

Thank you for playing Metaphor: ReFantazio!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.03
notes.notes:
Hi Metaphor: ReFantazio players, please see notes for patch 1.03 releasing today (Friday, 10/18):  
[list]
[*] Anti-aliasing feature implemented. Anti-aliasing can be adjusted in SETTINGS > Graphic Settings 
[*] Adjustments made to the Camera Shake Off feature 
[*] Adjustments made to audio volume balance 
[/list][i][b]Note:[/b] Today's patch increases the game's Master Volume. Please turn down your computer's volume before starting up and readjust the in-game Master Volume setting. We apologize for the inconvenience! [/i]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where New Game+ start save data wasn't generating correctly under certain conditions 
[*] Other minor fixes [/list]The patch will be applied automatically when the game is launched. 

Thank you for playing Metaphor: ReFantazio!

notes.title: Prologue Demo Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
We have released a patch to improve the graphics performance of the Steam version of “Metaphor: ReFantazio - Prologue Demo”. The patch will be automatically applied when the game is launched.

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Performance fixes: Adjustments made to relieve GPU stress
[*] GPU: Game will now choose highest spec (dedicated) GPU
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]*Performance fixes will continue to be made in the future.

We thank you for your continued support of Metaphor: ReFantazio!
